device.basis: GPIO controller Input pads read their data latch while it is set (the X-H2S companion START configures pad 0.4 and the peer-ready status depends on it). Pins 0.0 and 0.1 raise INTIDs 116 and 117 (records 1 and 2 of the X-E5 1.12 table at 0x01a62c58); pin 0.4 raises companion NVIC line 27 (X-H2S companion handler 0x18d50).
